pr_title: [CI] Add csrc cache for image build
source_quote: why not move this to L132?

correspondence.patch_snippet: 评后sha f0150ff 体现修改

rule.description: why not move this to L132?

antipattern.code:
# MengqingCao 评论: "why not move this to L132?"
# Potabk 回复: "ok, let's make it more concise"
# （根据评审意见推断）第144行的 CI 步骤位置不合理，应移至第132行

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: linux-arm64-cpu-16
    container:
      image: quay.io/ascend-ci/vllm-ascend:build
    steps:
      - name: Checkout source
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Build csrc
        run: |
          python setup.py build

      - name: Cache csrc artifacts
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: csrc/build
          key: csrc-${{ hashFiles('csrc/**') }}
          restore-keys: |
            csrc-

      # 以下步骤原位于第144行，评审建议移至第132行
      - name: Upload build artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: csrc-artifacts
          path: csrc/build/
